exposure: Preterm birth before 24 weeks of gestation
cohort: Infants born before 24 weeks of gestation in Sweden between 2007 and 2018
finding: Survival to hospital discharge increased for infants born before 24 weeks of gestation in Sweden between 2007 and 2018, but this was accompanied by an increase in severe neonatal morbidities.
mod_finding: Caesarean section rates increased for infants born at 22 weeks of gestation (from 12% to 22%, p = 0.038).
